newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER AGAINST UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEAKER AGAINST UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar registered further losses against hard currencies at the close of an otherwise fairly quiet Wednesday interbank session, dealers said.
"At one point the (exchange) rates came down to about 11.2450/2550 but all of a sudden they started (going) up again," one dealer said, adding: "But there were no major payments going out today."
"The (central) Reserve Bank don't seem to understand what's happening and they can't intervene unless they know what the fundamentals (driving the rates) are," the dealer said.

At Wednesday's close, the Zimbabwe dollar was quoted at 11.2575/2675 against the U.S. dollar from 11.2400/2500 on Tuesday and was also weaker against sterling at 17.9690/9960 compared to 17.8300/8500, largely tracking an easier U.S. currency on the British unit abroad.
It was at 6.6880/6950 from 6.6700/6900 against the mark and at 2.5415/5455 versus South Africa's rand, down from 2.5400/5600 the previous day.
